Era IV · A Plea for Resurrection
The Builders had seen too many of their own die in the Nether.
They made a decision — to ask the Scourge villagers for help.
Not a command. Not a demand —
A true plea, carried with gifts and with honesty.
They gathered the souls of their Nether-dead and gave them to the Scourge villagers.
They began to study the art of resurrection —
It was the very reason they had taken up the dark arts.
Souls into altars, Wither skeleton skulls for aid, soul sand for bedding…
But the art did not work.
The souls did not come back.
